stories.title: Worker routing for cms.kodigital.app — hostname-aware: ADMIN_HOST root → 302 /admin; ADMIN_HOST /admin* and /api/admin* → admin handlers; ADMIN_HOST other → 404; non-ADMIN_HOST /admin → 404 (D3)
acceptanceCriteria: BEHAVIORAL: GIVEN hostname == ADMIN_HOST AND path == '/' WHEN Worker handles request THEN response is 302 redirect to ADMIN_BASE_PATH ('/admin')

BEHAVIORAL: GIVEN hostname != ADMIN_HOST AND path == '/admin' WHEN Worker handles request THEN response status is 404 (not a redirect to CMS admin) — D3 policy: no admin host leak to public content domains
BEHAVIORAL: GIVEN hostname == ADMIN_HOST AND path starts with '/admin' WHEN authenticated request arrives THEN response is not 404 and not a redirect to cloudflareaccess.com in dev bypass mode

BEHAVIORAL: GIVEN hostname == ADMIN_HOST AND path is not '/admin*' and not '/api/admin*' and not '/' and not '/health' WHEN Worker handles request THEN response status is 404

stories.title: Cloudflare Access auth contract — JWT signature via JWKS-in-KV (24h TTL), exp/nbf/iat (typeof===number) + iss + aud validation; identity (email) vs service-token (common_name + optional ALLOWED_CF_SERVICE_TOKEN_IDS) modes; DEV_BYPASS_AUTH double-gate (APP_ENV !== 'production'); /api/admin/auth/status route; Web Crypto only
acceptanceCriteria: BEHAVIORAL: GIVEN APP_ENV=production AND DEV_BYPASS_AUTH=true WHEN request arrives at /admin without CF Access JWT THEN response is 401 NOT 200 — proving double-gate prevents bypass in production
BEHAVIORAL: GIVEN APP_ENV=local AND DEV_BYPASS_AUTH=true WHEN request arrives at /admin THEN response is 200 — local dev bypass works

BEHAVIORAL: GIVEN valid CF Access JWT with email claim WHEN request arrives at /api/admin/auth/status THEN response JSON contains {authenticated:true, mode:'identity', email:<value>} and does NOT contain secrets
BEHAVIORAL: GIVEN CF Access JWT with common_name (service token) but no email WHEN auth middleware runs THEN request is allowed (authenticated) without requiring email field
BEHAVIORAL: GIVEN ALLOWED_CF_SERVICE_TOKEN_IDS is set AND JWT common_name is NOT in the allowlist WHEN service-token auth runs THEN response is 403
grep -c 'crypto.subtle' api/src/auth/access-auth.ts >= 1 (Web Crypto only — no Node crypto)
